_doc: Jobs the server agent runs on its own. interval in minutes; cmd relative to the repo root; python3 = the agent's interpreter. Edit, commit, push: the server picks it up within 10 minutes.

jobs.note: POI layers of the top-1000 cities: ≤35 cities per run, two runs a day (Overpass fair use: ~70 queries/day), every city refreshed every 90 days

GHSL demand grids + terrain (GLO-30 + WorldCover water) for the top-1000 cities: ≤150 cities per 50-minute run, hourly until the initial bake is done (JRC/AWS have no fair-use cap; ~245 MB of tiles per run at most), tile-first; the 8 hand-baked cities are never touched
terrain of the 8 hand-baked launch cities (fleet/pinned_terrain, identical to the app's fixtures): verified against the served grid geometry and published when missing or different; daily, idempotent
local Caddy answers, served folder inventory, disk
